reason: Root independent neutral preflight found SwiftUI accessibility text bounds are not generic layout boxes; geometry rules now require explicit measurement scope.
decision: The pre-fixed 72 native-unit width and 12 native-unit gap describe visual marker layout boxes. Set measurement=layout_box; keep original numbers, tolerances, states, inputs, selectors and routes unchanged. Unsupported iOS layout box facts must remain unassessed even if AX happens to match.
replay_scope: New scoped checks replay the same unchanged native acquisition. No new render, no implementation edits, no target/input changes. Original contract, generated plans, tools snapshot, and checks preserved.
